title: Christchurch Park 2
text:
Well done to all those who took part in today's event in Christchurch Park - you can view the overall results here.

The final event in the series will be in Holywells Park on Sunday 26th June - & don't forget that anyone with a signed Ipswich-O 2022 Passport will get free entry to our other two Summer Series events, in Clare on 3rd July & in Needham Lake Country Park on 17th July. Both events will offer courses which will be ideal as a progression for those who've taken part in our Ipswich-O events.
